title: Simulator boot readiness through Gateway
description: Boot a free iOS simulator through resource.control, verify resource.health observes it running, then shut it down and verify it stopped.

check-slot.intent: Require a free slot before taking control of its simulator.
check-slot.cmd: FARMSLOT_RPC_TIMEOUT_MS=15000 FARMSLOT_GATEWAY=ws://127.0.0.1:{{params.gateway_port}}/ws node apps/command-center/scripts/cdp.mjs gateway fleet.status '{}' | jq -ec '.fleet.slots[] | select(.slot == "{{params.slot_id}}" and .lifecycle == "ready" and .currentRunId == null and .agent == "idle") | {slot,lifecycle,currentRunId,agent}'

check-stopped.intent: Require the simulator to be stopped before this recipe takes ownership of its boot.
check-stopped.cmd: for attempt in 1 2; do FARMSLOT_RPC_TIMEOUT_MS=15000 FARMSLOT_GATEWAY=ws://127.0.0.1:{{params.gateway_port}}/ws node apps/command-center/scripts/cdp.mjs gateway resource.health '{"slotId":"{{params.slot_id}}","resourceId":"ios-sim"}' | jq -ec '.resources[] | select(.id == "ios-sim" and .status == "stopped")' || exit 1; sleep 2; done

boot.intent: Boot through the Gateway, verify health, and restore the stopped state even when verification fails.

boot-succeeded.intent: Require the Gateway boot operation to report success.

health.intent: Require an observed running simulator, not only a successful boot RPC.

shutdown.intent: Require the Gateway shutdown operation to report success.

stopped.intent: Require the simulator to be stopped before releasing the slot.
